en: So as you saw, this scheduled tasks feature
is the first true automation actually.
You can run it daily, weekly, or on demand.
No specific prompt is needed here.
It's helpful for the automation as we saw
it. It can use local files, connectors. It
can also run with plugins and it uses skills
as we saw it.
And it is project aware. So if you let the
task run in a project, it inherits the
project instructions, the file context, the
memory.
So it uses all the knowledge, all the data
from inside your project to finish this task
successfully.
As mentioned, you have to be careful. The
computer must be awake and co-work desktop
must stay open to be able to run these
tasks.
In case this is not true, so in case you
didn't have the computer active or co-work
desktop was open,
missed runs are auto-executed once, once
you're back.
And what are some common scenarios? We
talked about this. This could be an email
reading and sorting idea. It could be
morning briefings or some summaries as we
saw them. What items are open on our list?
Which to-do items did we finish in the last
week? So it helps us to organize those
things for you without having to run tasks
again and again. So it helps to keep things
organized.
